title: Team Security Dashboard — Keys, SA Flows, and Audit Log Wireframes
content:
Goal
- Deliver a single "team security" surface where org admins and team admins can manage RBAC, API keys, service accounts (SA), and audit log exploration without context switching. Focus on minimizing accidental credential exposure and making revocation / rotation flows fast and reversible.

Audience and assumptions
- Primary: Org admins, security engineers, platform engineers at customer companies. Secondary: Developers who need to create short-lived keys for CI.
- Assumes customers will have a mix of human users, service accounts for CI/CD, and external integrations. Many will require key rotation, audit exports, and RBAC previews prior to rollout.
- Support model: hosted + dedicated + private; UI must surface differences only when necessary (e.g. KMS config in Private).

Top-level requirements (product):
1) Consolidated nav: toggle between Org / Team context at top-left. Toggle affects RBAC lists, keys, and audit view scope.
2) RBAC policy editor + simulator: table view for assignments + a 'simulate' panel to test a user/service-account against a permission set.
3) API keys list: labels, scopes, created_by, last_used, rotation status, expiry. Quick actions: copy (one-time masked), rotate, revoke.
4) Service accounts: create, attach key, attach roles, key lifecycle (short-lived vs long-lived), audit trail for key creation (who/when).
5) Audit log explorer: powerful filters (actor, resource, action, time range) + live tail mode for high-severity ops, export to CSV/LA.
6) Safety and anti-blunder UX: confirmation flows, masked tokens, 24-hour soft-delete for revoked keys, and recommended rotation cadence.

High-level layout (wireframe zones)
- Header: Org name + team selector dropdown + quick-create (+ Create key / Create SA / Invite member)
- Left rail: vertical nav: Overview | Members | Roles & Policies | Keys & SAs | Audit Log | Settings
- Main content area: area changes by selection. Default to 'Keys & SAs' in team context.
- Right rail (context pane): details for selected item; quick preview and actions.

Keys & Service Accounts screen — wireframe notes\- Top toolbar: scope pills (Org / Team / Project tags), search (name, id), filter dropdown (status, last_used < 30d, expiry, created_by).
- Primary table columns: Name | Type (human / SA) | Roles attached | Key count | Last used | Expires | Created by | Actions\- Row actions (dropdown): View details, Create key, Rotate key, Revoke key, Add role, Simulate access, More -> Export credentials (audit restricted).\- Row selection supports bulk revoke / bulk rotate operations. Bulk rotate should prompt for new key delivery method and parallel generation (non-blocking).
- Key detail modal: two sections — Metadata (create date, created_by, expiry, scope, environment note), Active keys list (active/expired/rotated), Last accessed timestamps, KMS binding if present.

Key copy UX and security rules\- Copy output: only available once after key creation; subsequent views show masked secret with 'Regenerate' option. Show clear microcopy: "This secret will not be shown again. Record it now."\- Soft-delete policy: when revoked, key is flagged 'revoked (soft)' for 24h to allow recovery by org admins. After 24h it's permanently deleted. Include audit entry for both actions.\- Rotation flow: allow 'rekey concurrently' for service accounts (old and new keys valid for a configurable overlap window). Default overlap = 2 hours but editable. UI shows timeline and recommends 1–2 hour overlap for CI pipelines.

Service Account creation flow (quick sketch)
1) Name + description + owner contact (email)
2) Roles selection (checkbox list) with inline permission preview (hover shows exemplar allowed API endpoints)
3) Key lifecycle policy: short-lived token (recommended) vs long-lived key (checkbox; show security warning)
4) Delivery method for keys: copy once / email (org policy) / KMS-wrapped pointer (private deployments)
5) Confirmation and immediate key creation modal (secret shown once)

RBAC surface and simulator\- Roles & Policies page should be a hybrid: top half role catalog (builtin + custom), bottom half role assignment table for the current scope (team/user/service account).\- Policy simulator: side rail panel where you paste/choose an actor and sample resource & action, click Run to see Allow / Deny and which policy granted / denied. Include an "Explain" overlay that shows the rule chain.\- Role creation UX: guided wizard with permission suggestions based on common tasks (read-only monitoring, inference-invoke-only, billing-admin). Provide templates for "CI runner" and "Human dev".

Audit Log explorer — wireframe and UX notes\- Key goals: fast filtering, quick pivot to implicated keys/SA/users, high-signal detection (failed auth, key exposure events).\- Filters: actor, source IP, resource id, action type, result (success/failure), severity, tags, team, time range presets & custom.\- Live tail mode: toggled on; shows only high-severity events by default unless user expands to include all. Live tail has a pause button and bookmarking.\- Event detail pane: includes full JSON for export, human-friendly summary, implicated keys/SA, links to related user or key objects, and 'create incident' quick action linking to the customer Success incident flow.\- Retention and export: UI shows retention window and an Export button to schedule exports to S3 / GCS or push to SIEM (Splunk/Datadog). For Private, show KMS export restrictions.

Copy text / microcopy examples (for design handoff)
- Create key CTA: "Create key (secret shown once)"
- Revoke confirmation: "Revoke key for service-account-foo? This will prevent all new auths with this key. Keys are soft-deleted for 24 hours and can be restored by org admins."
- Rotate warning: "Rotating will generate a new secret. Existing key will remain valid for overlap window of {X} hours."
- Simulation result pass: "Allowed — access to: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings (via role inference-invoke). Source policy: team/dev-ci-policy."

Accessibility and edge cases\- Keyboard-first operations: table rows should be focusable with keyboard shortcuts for quick revoke/rotate.\- Dark mode considerations: masked secrets should have sufficient contrast on reveal state.\- Rate-limited environments: provide a small spinner and non-blocking toast messages for long-running rotate/export ops.

Backlog grooming (prioritized actions)
- P0 (Sprint 1): Keys & SAs table + create-key modal + single-key copy-on-create + masked view + revoke (soft delete) flow. (3 dev + 1 design, 8 story points)
- P0 (Sprint 1): Audit log basic table + filters (actor, action, time) + event detail pane + CSV export. (2 dev + 1 infra, 8 story points)\- P1 (Sprint 2): RBAC simulator + role templates + attach role flow + permission previews. (2 dev, 1 design, 5 points)\- P1 (Sprint 2): Bulk rotate + overlap timer UI + recommended defaults + automation API. (2 dev, 1 design, 5 points)\- P2 (Sprint 3): Live tail for audit log + SIEM export + scheduled exports + retention UI. (3 dev, infra, 8 points)\- P2 (Sprint 3): Private deployment UI variations (KMS binding, key delivery restrictions). (2 dev, security review, 5 points)

Open questions / tradeoffs to decide\- Should API keys and service accounts be separate top-level tabs, or combined within a single 'Keys & SAs' screen? Combining reduces nav, but may add noise for large orgs.\- Default overlap for key rotations: 1 hour, 2 hours, or configurable per org? (ops preference vs simplicity).\- Soft-delete window length: standard 24h vs org-configurable. Security vs recoverability tradeoff.\- How much policy simulation should we provide in the UI vs a CLI tool? Full simulator may be heavy to maintain.

Design handoff checklist
- Figma frames for Keys table, Key detail modal, Create SA wizard, RBAC role editor, Policy simulator panel, Audit log live tail.
- Copy deck with microcopy strings and confirmation texts.
- Accessibility checklist: keyboard paths, contrast, aria labels for masked secrets.
- Example JSON payloads for events for audit log detail export.

Notes for engineering
- Backend: event stream indexing already exists in analytics cluster. Need to add actor->key/service-account reverse links in event schema for fast pivots.
- KMS integration: Private deployments may want to store only key fingerprints and KMS-wrapped pointers — wireframes must reflect that the secret won't be viewable in UI.
- Telemetry: track key creation, rotation, copy-once events, revoke/recover attempts, simulator runs. Use these to seed recommended rotation cadence.

Immediate next steps
- Sync with SRE to confirm feasibility of soft-delete 24h path (ETA 2 days).\- Kick off Figma frames (Ben) and initial dev spike for key copy-once (Marcus).\- Add UX acceptance criteria to ENG-1124 and split into subtasks for Sprint 1.

Appendix — quick scenario walkthroughs
1) CI rotation (happy path): create SA -> generate key (copy once) -> configure CI -> schedule rotation (overlap 2h) -> rotate -> CI picks up new key -> old key auto-revoke after overlap. Audit entries created for each step.
2) Accidental leak: dev posts key to public gist -> detection system flags (external) -> org admin searches audit log by key fingerprint -> revoke key (soft-delete) -> incident created and export spike to SIEM.

End of doc. 
(Notes: keep this doc as the working spec; will iterate after design sync 2025-11-18.)
